tagline: Bridge Zoom and Microsoft Teams for dual-platform organizations
metaTitle: Zoom + Microsoft Teams Integration: Summaries in Teams
metaDescription: Post Zoom meeting summaries and recording links to Teams channels, and send Teams reminders before Zoom calls. GAIA bridges both platforms. See the setup steps.
intro:
Many organizations run Zoom for video calls and Microsoft Teams for messaging, creating a split where meeting context lives in one platform and team communication in another. Colleagues who weren't on a call miss decisions, and chat notifications go unseen by people who live in the video app.

GAIA bridges the two so meeting summaries, recordings, and action items flow into the right channels automatically. Users of both stay informed and aligned without anyone manually copy-pasting between them.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to Microsoft Teams channels
useCases.description: After a call, GAIA formats the meeting summary and posts it to the designated channel. Team members who weren't on the call get full context without needing to watch the recording.

useCases.title: Send Teams reminders for upcoming Zoom meetings
useCases.description: GAIA posts a reminder in the relevant channel 15 minutes before a meeting starts, including the join link. Participants get the join link in Teams even when heads-down elsewhere.

useCases.title: Share recording links in channels
useCases.description: When a recording is ready, GAIA posts the link to the appropriate channel. Stakeholders access the recording in their primary collaboration tool without hunting through email.

useCases.title: Notify channels of meeting action items
useCases.description: GAIA extracts action items from meeting summaries and posts a structured list to the channel. Each item shows the owner and due date, giving the team a clear view of commitments made in the call.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Microsoft Teams to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Microsoft Teams tenant. Map meetings or meeting series to the corresponding channels.
Choose which events (meeting end, recording ready, action items) trigger posts, and set the format and channel for each notification type.
GAIA monitors your video account and posts structured updates to the chat channels automatically. Users on either side stay informed without manual handoffs.

faqs.question: Can GAIA also notify meeting participants about Teams messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can bridge in both directions — important channel messages can trigger a chat notification or email digest for participants who primarily use the video app for communication.

faqs.question: Does this work for organizations that use Zoom Rooms?
faqs.answer: GAIA integrates with Meetings and Webinars via the video provider's API. Rooms support depends on whether your plan exposes room meeting data through the same API.

faqs.question: Is there a risk of double-notifications if users have both apps open?
faqs.answer: GAIA posts to channels rather than individual DMs by default, so notifications appear as channel posts rather than personal pings. You can adjust per-channel notification settings to control alert frequency.
